OUR SUSTAINABILITY APPROACH
First Capital Treasuries PLC(FCT) occupies a critical role in the financial system, aligning investor capital with sovereign funding needs. As a
market intermediary and systemic channel for macroeconomic capital flows, we facilitate liquidity, monetary transmission, and price discovery in
the government securities market.
We embed our sustainability agenda within a framework built on four sustainability pillars, adapted from our intermediate parent company, First
Capital Holdings PLC (FCH), to fit our distinct business model.
